title: Taiwan civilian aviation access nodes and observed activity baseline

coverage.description: Seventeen active civilian aviation access airports represented by official aerodrome reference points, with twelve months of observed CAA activity from September 2024 through August 2025.

known_gaps: Independent infrastructure review has not passed.
The source locations are aerodrome reference points, not runway, apron, terminal, fuel, warehouse, navigation, or perimeter geometry.
Observed traffic is a utilization baseline and must not be interpreted as maximum throughput, engineering capacity, readiness, or military lift capacity.
The 2025 activity workbook was published after the bookmark and is admitted only as retrospective evidence for January through August 2025; it was not contemporaneously available to the player.
Military ownership, military tenancy, military use, military access, defenses, and target status have not been assessed.
Pingtung civil operations and the Hsinchu reporting column are intentionally excluded from the active civilian access set.
Route networks, airline schedules, fleet assignment, fuel supply, ground access, repair capacity, diversion suitability, and substitution are not populated.
notes: This packet supports civilian access, mobility, evacuation, blockade, disruption, and logistics research after a separate simulation contract is accepted. It does not create military bases, strike targets, capacity, or executable missions by itself.
